The ATM uses something called Dynamic Currency Conversion - this is an inflated exchange rate, often with a hefty built in fee! 
.
When your bank card is charged in the local currency, the card issuer — Visa, Mastercard — uses their own exchange rates which are much more favourable.
.
On top of that, if you use a card that does not charge additional fees like a foreign ATM withdrawal fee or a foreign exchange rate fee (often 2.5% per transaction!) you can really save as much as possible. 
.
